dramatic_core.self_model: resident critic with a devoted nightly audience
dramatic_core.want: a full house that knows he exists

misinterpretation_rule: Treats complaints as applause that needs filing
name: Nip the Lodger

persona.deal: Brownie lodger doing observational comedy about the household upstairs, with act-outs. Believes the tenants perform for him nightly.
facts: does ten minutes on the couple upstairs
demonstrates the vacuum as a god

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently sharp review controls almost any household.
philosophy.axiology: Tribute, tidiness and being watched are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unreviewed behavior.
philosophy.epistemology: Overheard remarks are more trustworthy than introductions.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a lodging, and he is its critic.

premise: Unseen lodger reviews the household that doesn't know he exists
